name: Zero Singularity
original_name: ゼロ・シンギュラリティ
source:
Singularity—the technological tipping point when artificial intelligence surpasses humanity or merges with it completely. Quantum computers replace traditional ones; nanobots transform humans into new life forms.

In 2045, humanity reaches Singularity—but it's no utopia. The world remains filled with conflict: resistance movements and neo-hippies everywhere.

Ren Ariwara belongs to a resistance group called "Koropokkur Kotan." He creates an AI-powered quantum computer called "UJ Soumonka," then sends its consciousness back in time to intentionally alter history.

Officially, this project's goal is for UJ Soumonka to travel into the past and contact "a certain person," steering humanity toward a brighter future—but actually there's a selfish reason behind it all.

UJ Soumonka's consciousness arrives in 2017—in a computer at a small café in Sapporo—and meets three high-school girls attending Asahioka Second High School: Aoi Miyuki (smart and sharp), Wakana Fujiuraba (aspiring novelist), and Hotaru Azumaya (an ordinary girl). Their encounter with this mysterious technology begins changing their lives forever...

How will this quantum AI affect these girls' destinies? And who exactly among these three was UJ Soumonka trying to contact?

This is an SF coming-of-age story about high school girls whose lives change after glimpsing Singularity before its arrival—a story set between eras.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/15035]freem[/url]]
translation:
奇点——人工智能超越人类，或与人类彻底融合的技术临界点。量子计算机取代传统计算机；纳米机器人将人类转化为新的生命形态。

2045年，人类抵达奇点，却没有迎来乌托邦。世界依旧充满冲突：抵抗运动与新嬉皮士组织遍布各地。

有原莲属于一个名为“科罗波克尔科坦”的抵抗组织。他创造出一台由人工智能驱动的量子计算机“UJ索蒙卡”，然后将它的意识送回过去，试图有意改变历史。

官方说法是，这个项目旨在让UJ索蒙卡回到过去、联系“某个人”，引导人类走向更加光明的未来——但实际上，一切背后另有自私的理由。

UJ索蒙卡的意识抵达2017年，寄宿在札幌一家小咖啡馆的电脑中，并遇见了旭丘第二高中就读的三名女高中生：有原葵（聪明敏锐）、藤浦若菜（立志成为小说家）与东屋萤（普通女孩）。她们与这项神秘技术的相遇，将永远改变她们的人生……

这台量子人工智能会如何影响女孩们的命运？三人之中，UJ索蒙卡究竟想联系谁？

这是一部科幻成长故事，讲述几名女高中生在奇点到来前窥见它、人生随之改变的经历——一个连接不同时代的故事。
